processes.label: Act of Working
processes.title: Act of Working
processes.subtitle: A CCO Planned Act of performing work for an organization: person, organization, site, temporal region, role, mission, skills and contract decomposed across the seven BFO buckets.
processes.definition: A Planned Act, and an Act of Employment, in which a person performs work for an organization at a site over a temporal region, realizing an employee role, developing skills, under an employment contract.
processes.example: Alice Dupont working as COO for Demo, worldwide, since April 2023.
processes.comment: Act of Working is the process counterpart to employment continuants (EmploymentRecord, EmployeeRole). The role is the WHY that inheres in the person; the Mission it concretizes is the stated remit and is a GDC, so it survives the person leaving the post.

when.label: Temporal region · first and last instant (last absent while ongoing)

restrictions.definition: Every act of working is performed for an organization.
The act is executed at a site.
The act spans a temporal region bounded by a first instant and, unless ongoing, a last instant.
The act realizes the employee role borne by the person. The role concretizes a JobPosition and a Mission, both GDCs.
Skills are qualities inhering in the person, exercised and developed in the act. One skill node is shared by every act that develops it.
The role concretizes the mission: rdfs:label carries the opening sentence, personnel:mission_content the full stated text.
restrictions.example: Lead platform operations and agent orchestration…

restrictions.definition: Provenance: every asserted mission points back at the profile page it was read from.
Links a person to each act of working they perform.

processes.label: Act of Studying
processes.title: Act of Studying
processes.subtitle: A CCO Planned Act of educational training acquisition: person, educational organization, site, temporal region, student role, skills, enrollment record and academic degree.
processes.definition: A Planned Act, and an Act of Educational Training Acquisition, in which a person acquires knowledge of a curriculum from an educational organization at a site over a temporal region, realizing a student role, developing skills, under an enrollment record and academic degree.
processes.example: Alice Dupont studying for a Master's Degree in Corporate Finance at Demo Business School in Bordeaux from 2012 to 2016.
processes.comment: Act of Studying is the process counterpart to study continuants (EnrollmentRecord, StudentRole, AcademicDegree). Enrollment records and degrees point back to the education profile page through personnel:isSourcedFrom.

when.label: Temporal region · first and last instant

how_to_know.label: Enrollment record · Academic degree · Profile document

restrictions.definition: Every act of studying is performed with an educational organization.
The act is executed at a site.
The act spans a temporal region bounded by a first instant and a last instant.
The act realizes the student role borne by the person.
Concretizes the enrollment record that documents the course of study.
Concretizes the academic degree awarded for the course of study.
Skills are qualities inhering in the person, exercised and developed in the act.
Provenance: every enrollment record points back at the education profile page it was read from.
Links a person to an act of studying.
restrictions.example: Alice Dupont → Master's Degree, Corporate Finance @ Demo Business School
